# Example Project Context

## Project Name

Customer Management Platform

---

## Goal

Provide a platform to manage customers, contracts, and billing operations.

---

## Main Users

- Admins
- Sales teams
- Finance teams

---

## Business Domain

B2B SaaS platform for customer operations management.

---

## Main Features

- Customer management
- Authentication and authorization
- Contract management
- Billing operations
- Audit logs

---

## Technical Constraints

- Must support multi-tenant architecture.
- Must support role-based permissions.
- Must expose REST APIs.
- Must support horizontal scaling.

---

## Architecture

- Clean Architecture
- Modular Monolith
- Domain-oriented modules

---

## Tech Stack

- Node.js
- TypeScript
- PostgreSQL
- Prisma
- Redis
- Docker

---

## Testing Strategy

- Unit tests
- Integration tests
- Contract tests
- End-to-end tests for critical flows

---

## Security Requirements

- JWT authentication
- Role-based authorization
- Encrypted secrets
- Audit logging
